items.title: CISA Flags Four Actively Exploited Flaws — Patch These Now
items.summary:
CISA just added four vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog — meaning attackers are actively using them right now. The flaws affect GPUStack (AI model server), SignalWire FreeSWITCH (VoIP), OpenBSD OpenSSH, and IBM Aspera Faspex (file transfer). If your computer runs any of these, update immediately.

What to do: Check for updates on every program you use. Turn on automatic updates in your system settings and in each application's settings. Most of these patches are already available from the vendors.

Why it matters: Actively exploited flaws are the ones criminals use first. Delaying updates leaves the door open.

items.title: CISA Flags Four Actively Exploited Flaws — GPUStack FreeSWITCH OpenSSH Aspera Faspex
items.summary: CISA added four vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 9 2026 based on active exploitation. The flaws affect GPUStack (CVE-2026-102895) SignalWire FreeSWITCH (CVE-2026-116779) OpenBSD OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158) and IBM Aspera Faspex (CVE-2026-123218). Organizations should prioritize patching these immediately. Check the catalog at cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog

items.title: **Headline:** Microsoft Releases November Patch Tuesday Updates — Windows, Office, Edge
items.summary: Microsoft released its November 2026 Patch Tuesday updates this afternoon covering Windows 11, Windows 10, Office, and Microsoft Edge. The updates address 78 security vulnerabilities across the product line including 6 rated Critical. Install via Settings > Windows Update and restart when prompted.

items.title: Firefox 160 Adds On-Device Speech Recognition in 40 Languages — Free Update at firefox.com
items.summary: Firefox 160 was released November 10 2026 and includes on-device speech recognition using the Web Speech API for real-time speech-to-text conversion in 40 languages. Works on desktop offline with no cloud processing. Update free at firefox.com or open Settings > About Firefox to check for updates.

items.title: Fake Windows 11 24H2 Update Scam Steals Data — Patch Tuesday Tomorrow
items.summary: A convincing fake Windows 11 24H2 update page is circulating. It mimics a Microsoft support site, uses a believable cumulative-update name, and offers a blue download button for an 83 MB installer. The file is a malicious MSI built with legitimate tools that hides an infostealer

items.title: Chrome 157 Security Update Fixes 213 Bugs Including 7 Critical — Update at chrome://settings/help
items.summary: Chrome 157 patches 213 security holes including seven critical flaws in graphics, memory handling, and browser features. Update now at chrome://settings/help — it takes two minutes and protects against memory corruption and graphics exploits.

items.title: Thunderbird Puts Every Email Account in One Free App — No Subscription at thunderbird.net
items.summary: Thunderbird manages Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, and custom accounts in one unified inbox. Free, open-source, no subscription at thunderbird.net — works on Windows, Mac, and Linux.

items.title: DaVinci Resolve Free Edits 4K Video with No Watermark — Download at blackmagicdesign.com
items.summary: DaVinci Resolve Free includes professional editing, color grading, VFX, and audio up to 4K 60fps. No watermark, no subscription, no time limit. Download at blackmagicdesign.com.

items.title: Microsoft PowerToys Gives You 25+ Free Windows Power Tools — Install from Microsoft Store
items.summary: PowerToys adds bulk file rename, keyboard remapping, always-on-top window, color picker, image resizer, and 20+ utilities to Windows. Free at Microsoft Store or github.com/microsoft/PowerToys — one install, all tools.

items.title: CISA Confirms Three New Actively Exploited Flaws This Week — SonicWall, Apple, WordPress
items.summary: CISA added three vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited list this week: SonicWall SSLVPN, an Apple authentication flaw, and a WordPress race condition. Update affected systems now — check the CISA KEV catalog for details.

items.title: DAILY BRIEF — Chrome 157 Patches 213 Flaws, CISA Flags SonicWall/Apple/WordPress
items.summary: Chrome 157 fixes 213 security bugs including 7 critical — update at chrome://settings/help. CISA confirms three new actively exploited flaws: SonicWall SSLVPN, Apple authentication, WordPress core. Patch affected systems immediately.
